question: When did Prof. Marco Andrea Garuti pass away?
answer: Students, Staff and the Administration of the National Advanced School of Public Works (ENSTP) in Yaounde yesterday August 25, 2021 gave academic honours to their departed Prof. Marco Andrea Garuti who died on July 28th, 2021 in Spain after a brief illness.
